in_marathi.name: Kinnara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kinnara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kinnaras are celestial beings who are musicians in Hindu mythology. They are said to be the companions of the gods and create melodious music that soothes their hearts.
